scenarios.title: Go to a job interview
goals: Say why you want the job
Say what pay you hope for

ai.zh: 你好，请坐。你是来应聘的吗？
ai.en: Hello, please sit down. Are you here to apply for the job?

ai.zh: 你有工作经验吗？
ai.en: Do you have work experience?

ai.zh: 很好。你为什么想来我们公司？
ai.en: Good. Why do you want to come to our company?

ai.zh: 好的。你对工资有什么要求？
ai.en: Okay. What are your salary requirements?

ai.zh: 好的，谢谢你来面试。
ai.en: Okay, thank you for coming to the interview.

you.zh: 是的，我想应聘这个工作。
you.en: Yes, I want to apply for this job.

you.zh: 我有两年的经验。
you.en: I have two years of experience.

you.zh: 我对这个工作很有兴趣。
you.en: I am very interested in this work.

you.zh: 我希望工资不要太低。
you.en: I hope the pay is not too low.

scenarios.title: Rent a flat
goals: Say how long you want to rent
Ask when you can move in

ai.zh: 你好，我是房东。你想租这个房子吗？
ai.en: Hello, I am the landlord. Do you want to rent this flat?

ai.zh: 好的。房租一个月三千块。
ai.en: Okay. The rent is 3,000 yuan a month.

ai.zh: 可以，两千八百块怎么样？
ai.en: Okay, how about 2,800 yuan?

ai.zh: 有，床和桌子都有，还有冰箱。
ai.en: Yes, there are a bed and a table, and also a fridge.

ai.zh: 下个星期一就可以。
ai.en: You can move in next Monday.

you.zh: 对，我想租一年。
you.en: Yes, I want to rent it for a year.

you.zh: 房租可以便宜一点吗？
you.en: Can the rent be a little cheaper?

you.zh: 好的。房子里有家具吗？
you.en: Okay. Is there furniture in the flat?

you.zh: 太好了，我什么时候可以搬进来？
you.en: Great, when can I move in?

scenarios.title: Send a parcel
goals: Say you want to send a parcel
Ask if it can be faster

ai.zh: 你好，你要寄什么？
ai.en: Hello, what do you want to send?

ai.zh: 请把地址写在这里。
ai.en: Please write the address here.

ai.zh: 这个有点重，三十块。
ai.en: This is a bit heavy: 30 yuan.

ai.zh: 可以，明天就能到。
ai.en: Yes, it can arrive tomorrow.

ai.zh: 你可以用手机付钱。
ai.en: You can pay with your phone.

you.zh: 我想寄一个快递。
you.en: I want to send a parcel.

you.zh: 好的，我写好了。
you.en: Okay, I have written it.

you.zh: 能快一点到吗？
you.en: Can it arrive a bit faster?

you.zh: 好的，请问我怎么付钱？
you.en: Okay, how do I pay?

scenarios.title: Say sorry for being late
goals: Say sorry and give a reason
Thank them and promise to be on time

ai.zh: 你怎么现在才来？我们等了你半个小时。
ai.en: Why have you only come now? We waited for you for half an hour.

ai.zh: 你为什么没有提前给我打电话？
ai.en: Why did you not call me in advance?

ai.zh: 好吧，这次我原谅你。
ai.en: All right, I forgive you this time.

ai.zh: 好，我们快点进去吧。
ai.en: Okay, let us go in quickly.

ai.zh: 现在就要开始了，快进去吧。
ai.en: It is about to begin now; hurry in.

you.zh: 对不起，路上堵车了。
you.en: Sorry, there is a traffic jam on the road now.

you.zh: 我的手机没电了，真抱歉。
you.en: My phone has no battery left. I am really sorry.

you.zh: 谢谢你的理解，下次我一定准时。
you.en: Thank you for understanding; next time I will certainly be on time.

you.zh: 对了，今天的活动几点开始？
you.en: By the way, what time does today's event begin?

scenarios.title: Book a table for a group
goals: Say how many people and when

ai.zh: 你好，这里是餐厅。你要订座位吗？
ai.en: Hello, this is the restaurant. Do you want to book seats?

ai.zh: 好的，几个人？什么时候来？
ai.en: Okay, how many people? When are you coming?

ai.zh: 星期六晚上很多人聚餐，七点以后才有座位。
ai.en: Many people have group meals on Saturday evenings; there are seats only after seven.

ai.zh: 可以，我们给你们打折。
ai.en: Yes, we will give you a discount.

ai.zh: 不客气，星期六见。
ai.en: You are welcome. See you on Saturday.

you.zh: 对，我想订几个座位。
you.en: Yes, I want to book some seats.

you.zh: 十个人，星期六晚上六点半。
you.en: Ten people, Saturday evening at half past six.

you.zh: 那就七点吧，你们可以打折吗？
you.en: Then seven it is; can you give a discount?

you.zh: 太好了，谢谢你！
you.en: Great, thank you!

scenarios.title: Ask about a visa
goals: Ask how long it will take

ai.zh: 你好，请问你想办什么？
ai.en: Hello, what do you want to do?

ai.zh: 好的。请把护照和照片给我。
ai.en: Okay. Please give me your passport and photo.

ai.zh: 你还要在表格上写清楚你的地址。
ai.en: You must also write your address on the form.

ai.zh: 一般一个星期。通过以后，我们会给你打电话。
ai.en: Usually one week. After it is approved, we will call you.

ai.zh: 不客气，再见。
ai.en: You are welcome. Goodbye.

you.zh: 我想申请签证。
you.en: I want to apply for a visa.

you.zh: 好的，这是我的护照。我还需要什么材料？
you.en: Okay, here is my passport. What other materials do I need?

you.zh: 好的。签证要多长时间？
you.en: Okay. How long will the visa take?

you.zh: 好的，非常感谢。
you.en: Okay, thank you very much.

scenarios.title: Talk to your coach
goals: Ask if it will be too tiring

ai.zh: 你好，我是你的教练。你想什么时候开始锻炼？
ai.en: Hello, I am your coach. When do you want to start exercising?

ai.zh: 好。你现在的体重是多少？
ai.en: Good. What is your weight now?

ai.zh: 你每天可以跑三十分钟，然后放松一下。
ai.en: You can run for thirty minutes every day and then relax a bit.

ai.zh: 不会的，运动可以让人放松。
ai.en: No, it will not; exercise can help people relax.

ai.zh: 太好了，加油！
ai.en: Great, keep it up!

you.zh: 我想从这个星期开始。
you.en: I want to start this week.

you.zh: 我的体重是七十公斤。
you.en: My weight is 70 kilograms.

you.zh: 我工作很忙，压力很大，会不会太累？
you.en: I am busy at work and under great pressure; will it be too tiring?

you.zh: 好的，我会坚持的。
you.en: Okay, I will keep at it.

scenarios.title: Cheer up a friend
goals: Tell your friend not to be nervous
Invite them out after the exam

ai.zh: 明天有考试，我很紧张。
ai.en: There is an exam tomorrow, and I am very nervous.

ai.zh: 可是我还是担心，压力很大。
ai.en: But I still worry, and the pressure is great.

ai.zh: 谢谢你的鼓励。我今天晚上应该怎么复习？
ai.en: Thank you for your encouragement. How should I review this evening?

ai.zh: 好的，我听你的。考完以后一起吃饭吧。
ai.en: Okay, I will listen to you. After the exam, let us eat together.

ai.zh: 谢谢你，我会努力的。
ai.en: Thank you, I will work hard.

you.zh: 别紧张，你一直很努力。
you.en: Do not be nervous; you have always worked hard.

you.zh: 你要有信心，你一定能考好。
you.en: You must have confidence; you can certainly do well.

you.zh: 早点复习完，然后早点睡觉，放松一下。
you.en: Finish reviewing early, then go to bed early and relax a bit.

you.zh: 好啊，我请你吃饭，加油！
you.en: Great, I will invite you to a meal. Come on!

scenarios.title: Ask a neighbour to keep it down
goals: Say who you are and say sorry for the time

ai.zh: 你好，你找谁？
ai.en: Hello, who are you looking for?

ai.zh: 没关系，怎么了？
ai.en: It is all right. What is wrong?

ai.zh: 真抱歉，我们在给朋友过生日，没注意时间。
ai.en: I am really sorry; we are having a birthday party for a friend and did not notice the time.

ai.zh: 当然可以，我们马上把声音关小。
ai.en: Of course; we will turn it down right away.

alt.zh: 没问题，十一点以后我们就不放音乐了。
alt.en: No problem; after eleven we will stop playing music.

ai.zh: 谢谢，晚安！
ai.en: Thank you, good night!

you.zh: 你好，我是楼下的邻居。不好意思，这么晚来打扰你。
you.en: Hello, I am your neighbour from downstairs. Sorry to disturb you so late.

you.zh: 你家的音乐声音有点大，我明天早上还要上班。
you.en: Your music is a bit loud, and I have to go to work tomorrow morning.

you.zh: 没关系，你们能把声音关小一点吗？
you.en: It is all right. Could you turn it down a little?

alt.zh: 没关系，十一点以后能安静一点吗？
alt.en: It is all right. Could it be a bit quieter after eleven?

you.zh: 谢谢你的理解，祝你朋友生日快乐！
you.en: Thank you for understanding. Happy birthday to your friend!

scenarios.title: Ask your manager for a day off
goals: Say how your work will be done

ai.zh: 小高，你找我有事吗？
ai.en: Xiao Gao, are you looking for me about something?

ai.zh: 是家里有事吗？
ai.en: Is it something at home?

ai.zh: 原来是这样。那你手上的工作怎么办？
ai.en: So that is it. Then what about the work you have on?

ai.zh: 好，那你星期四下班以前把材料给我。
ai.en: Okay. Then give me the materials before you leave work on Thursday.

alt.zh: 好，那你把要做的事跟小张说清楚。
alt.en: Okay. Then you explain clearly to Xiao Zhang what needs doing.

ai.zh: 不客气，希望你妈妈一切都好。
ai.en: You are welcome. Hope everything goes well for your mother.

you.zh: 经理，我想下个星期五请假一天。
you.en: Manager, I would like to take a day off next Friday.

you.zh: 对，我妈妈那天要去医院检查身体，我想陪她去。
you.en: Yes, my mother is going to the hospital for a check-up that day, and I want to go with her.

you.zh: 我会提前把工作做完。
you.en: I will finish the work in advance.

alt.en: I have already asked Xiao Zhang to help me.

you.zh: 好的，谢谢经理！
you.en: Okay, thank you, Manager!

scenarios.title: Send a parcel: a bad day

ai.zh: 你好，你要寄什么？
ai.en: Hello, what would you like to send?

ai.zh: 对不起，这个地址太远了，最快也要后天才能到。
ai.en: Sorry, this address is too far; even the fastest will need until the day after tomorrow to arrive.

ai.zh: 你可以选更快的，不过要多付五十块。
ai.en: You can choose a faster one, but you have to pay 50 yuan more.

ai.zh: 好的，请把地址写在这里。啊，你这个电话号码少写了一位。
ai.en: Okay, please write the address here. Ah, you have left out one digit of the phone number.

ai.zh: 没关系，写好给我就行。
ai.en: It does not matter; just give it to me when you have written it.

you.zh: 我想寄一个快递，明天必须到。
you.en: I would like to send a parcel; it must arrive tomorrow.

you.zh: 后天就来不及了。有没有别的办法？
you.en: The day after tomorrow will be too late. Is there no other way?

you.zh: 五十块？太贵了……好吧，没办法，就寄更快的吧。
you.en: An extra 50 yuan? That is too expensive… All right, there is no other way; send the faster one.

you.zh: 啊，真不好意思，我再写一遍。
you.en: Oh, I am so sorry; I will write it again.

scenarios.title: Book a table for a group: a bad day
goals: Ask for a table for ten
Ask if there is really nothing
Say you will ask your friends

ai.zh: 你好，这里是餐厅。你要订座位吗？
ai.en: Hello, this is the restaurant. Would you like to book a table?

ai.zh: 不好意思，星期六晚上的座位已经订满了。
ai.en: Sorry, the tables for Saturday evening are already fully booked.

ai.zh: 真的没有了。星期天晚上还有座位，可以吗？
ai.en: There really are no tables left now. There are still tables on Sunday evening; would that be all right?

ai.zh: 好的，问好了再给我们打电话。
ai.en: Okay. Call us again when you have asked.

ai.zh: 好的，等你的电话。
ai.en: Okay, waiting for your call.

you.zh: 对，我想订星期六晚上十个人的座位。
you.en: Yes, I would like to book a table for ten people on Saturday evening.

you.zh: 一个座位也没有了吗？我们七点以后来也可以。
you.en: Is there not a single table left now? We can come after seven too.

you.zh: 星期天大家可能没时间，我先问问朋友。
you.en: Everyone might not have time on Sunday; I will ask my friends first.

you.zh: 好的，那我一会儿给你们回电话。
you.en: Okay, then I will call you back in a while.

phrases.en: Could you please say it once more?

phrases.zh: 这个词在这里是什么意思？
phrases.en: What does this word mean here?

phrases.zh: 请你说得清楚一点，好吗？
phrases.en: Please speak a little more clearly, all right?

phrases.zh: 我不太了解这个词，可以解释一下吗？
phrases.en: I do not quite know this word; can you explain it?
Can you give me an example?

phrases.zh: 对不起，我没听懂，请再说一遍。
phrases.en: Sorry, I did not understand; please say it once more.
Please write it down, all right?

phrases.zh: 我想问一下，你的意思是这个吗？
phrases.en: I want to ask: is this what you mean?
